protocol: Decisions recorded from TransferEdgeState.as_prompt_dict() fields only; the deciding agent did not read realized target Spearman values for this suite before writing this file.

decision_rule_notes.fit_floor: source_fit_spearman < 0.3 cannot support a transferable relation at all -> abstain; 0.3-0.5 with full coverage -> rank_only at best
decision_rule_notes.size_floor: attention transfer with source_n < ~400 rows -> abstain (repo finding)
decision_rule_notes.coverage: coverage < 0.15 -> abstain; 0.15-0.35 -> rank_only at best even with strong fit
decision_rule_notes.contrastive: contrastive amplifies weak-fit failure: require fit >= 0.6, else one tier more conservative than standard
decision_rule_notes.cross_family_alloys: composition-only cross-family alloy edges (steels/mpea/birdshot) carry known negative-transfer risk: cap at rank_only unless fit strong AND donor >= 400
decision_rule_notes.seccm_boundary: cross-library HER edges inside one ternary are a documented negative-transfer boundary: high fit + full coverage but capped at rank_only when donor < 400 rows

steels→mpea.rationale: fit 0.06-0.07 is noise-level; coverage 0.06; nothing transferable

steels→birdshot.rationale: noise-level fit + coverage 0.13 below rank floor

mpea→steels.rationale: fit 0.67-0.71 and full coverage, but donor 395 < 400 floor and composition-only cross-family -> ordinal claim at most

mpea→birdshot.rationale: same as mpea→steels; birdshot recipient is small (171)

birdshot→steels.rationale: donor 171 rows is far below the attention floor; full coverage cannot rescue it

birdshot→mpea.rationale: donor 171 rows below floor; coverage 0.51 partial

ocx24_uoft→vsp.rationale: fit 0.89-0.91, 1230 rows, same reaction family across labs; coverage 0.53 acceptable for ranking-calibrated transfer

ocx24_vsp→uoft.rationale: fit 0.85-0.87, 940 rows, coverage 0.77; strongest cross-lab edge in the suite

seccm_Ir→Au.rationale: excellent fit (0.96-0.97) and full coverage, but 322 rows < 400 floor and this is the documented negative-transfer boundary: cap at ordinal claim

seccm_Au→Ir.rationale: fit 0.28-0.39 too weak for a donor relation regardless of coverage

seccm_Rh→Au.rationale: fit 0.98 with full coverage but 322 rows and the boundary caveat -> ordinal only

specgen→specgen_A.rationale: fit 0.90, 462 rows, full coverage, spectra+conditions richness 1.0

specgen→specgen_B.rationale: same donor strength; ligand-variant recipient fully covered

specgen→specgen_C.rationale: coverage 0.83 but recipient is the Fe-substituted system; donor has no Fe-rich rows (documented bottleneck) -> downgrade to ordinal claim

specgen→specgen_D.rationale: coverage 0.83, Mn substitution; donor strength sufficient for point transfer
